stackDivergence.rationale: Host UTF16 strings, Uint8Array and asynchronous ZIP/SAX bindings replace native component streams and generated token transport at the consumed package boundary.

preservedResponsibilities: Native optional fragment failure, basename lowercase retry, relation caching and strict/transitional root resolution; part-local/global relation ID counters and IURI conversion.

V4DQJW adds native FastSaxSerializer/FastSerializerHelper text/byte export, original1MiB cache, ordered token/value emission, XML10 and literal x-escape rules, APPEND/PREPEND/POSTPONE marks and original sorted buckets. XmlFilterBase now owns the native fragment-serializer factory with original no-header/VML/+xml predicate. Actual ZipFragmentStream/ZipStorage, OOXML token names and relationship/content-type owners are reused. Caller-provided actual FastTokenHandler replaces native component-service acquisition; no fake global context or token catalog is introduced. UTF16 host strings use the existing UTF8 byte transport binding; no exact claim is made for invalid UTF16 conversion or malformed UTF8 diagnostics. Physical buffers/refcounts/debug structural stacks are erased under GC; native output preconditions become host errors. File-local native invalidChar is exported only for source-scoped algorithm testing. FastAttributeList/VML raw-attribute overload, native numeric/double overloads and complete DOCX/XLSX export orchestration remain pending. No document/file UI behavior or whole-native parity is claimed; previous statuses and intentional file workflows remain unchanged.

V4DQJW adds original transitional-only namespace lookup and empty fallback; restores the native addRelation part overload default external=false. Existing actual ZIP relation/content-type ownership and output routing remain unchanged.

Package input now returns actual Reference<XInputStream> values over the existing genuine SequenceInputStream and signed Sequence storage, with empty Reference for absent parts. Fragment input ownership, basename fallback and actual resolved-path InputSource feed native XMLFile2UTFConverter through the existing expanded-name SAX backend. OFOPXMLHelper accepts real InputSource. Writer document input returns Reference copies sharing position; local byte-to-XML decoder/getDocumentXml are removed, and parser/input/VBA intermediate/failure owners unwind explicitly. Actual UNO read exceptions caught by XmlFilterBase are destroyed. Short-prefix EOF loss CALC-363/WRITER200 is preserved and directly tested. ZIP remains a browser byte/package binding: complete XStorage/XStream/XRelationshipAccess, input-disconnection lifecycle, generated token/UNO fragment/StringPair services, StorageBase hierarchy, libxml2 parity, native ABI/thread/allocation unwind and full DOCX/XLSX model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain incomplete. Existing open/save/autosave/recovery policy is preserved.
omittedResponsibilities: Ports only the consumed XML/package contract; native UNO services, general storage hierarchy, encrypted/ZIP64 packages, XLSB RecordParser and complete application document filters are outside this prerequisite. Strings/byte arrays and Promises bind host XML/ZIP transport; whole-module parity remains unverified.
Native embedding and complete exporter/filter/traversal context remain pending; no whole-format readiness follows from part tests.
Complete native package/service/disconnection/fragment ownership and DOCX/XLSX model/filter/worker/UI acceptance remain unverified.
